title: Step 1: Describe a Room
story: You are building a text adventure: Escape the Village. First, the narrator must be able to describe where you are.
goal: Write describe(room): return "<room>: exits <a>, <b>" with the exits sorted alphabetically. ROOMS is given.
hints: ROOMS[room]["exits"] is a dictionary. Its keys are the directions.
sorted(...) puts the exits in order and ", ".join(...) glues them with commas.
socratic: Which part of ROOMS holds the exits?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
